indicators.flag: Client moves funds sourced from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, within a short period of time to one or more of the following sectors: real estate, investments, automotive and/or the legal profession.
indicators.red_flag: Rapid onward sweep of China/Hong-Kong-sourced funds into real-estate / investment / automotive / legal sectors (layering pass-through)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are immediately transferred to a client’s associated personal or businesses account(s) or to unrelated party(ies).
indicators.red_flag: Immediate fan-out of inbound China/HK funds to own associated accounts or unrelated parties (mule receive-and-forward)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Client has ties to China and is using their accounts for pass-through activities funded by individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, whose relationship is unclear.
indicators.red_flag: Account used as pass-through funded by no-relationship China/HK remitters (mule conduit)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Client is receiving funds from entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, that are connected to the money service business industry, with no ultimate remitting party names listed.
indicators.red_flag: Inbound MSB-channel China/HK transfers with no ultimate-remitter name (originator obscured)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D3.

indicators.flag: Funds are received from entities in China, notably in Hong Kong, with limited to no online presence and there are no details relating to the types of services offered by the sending entity.
indicators.red_flag: Inbound funds from no-web-footprint China/HK sender with undefined business activity (shell originator)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Stated purpose of incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, is for the purchase of property but the funds were used to purchase Guaranteed Investment Certificates.
indicators.red_flag: Stated-purpose vs actual-use mismatch — property-purpose China/HK funds diverted into GICs
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D5.

indicators.flag: Business accounts are funded by multiple transfers, mainly from the business’ directors and/or authorized signatories’ personal accounts.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-originator funnel-in of business account from directors'/signatories' personal accounts (insider funding)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Adverse media mentions client, or related transacting parties of the client, as being linked to criminal activity such as fraud, possession of proceeds of crime, corruption/bribery, or illicit gambling/betting charges.
indicators.red_flag: Adverse-media hit on client or counterparties (fraud / POC / corruption / illicit gambling)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds of unknown origin sent by individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, to a real estate-related party (e.g., real estate agent/brokerage or real estate developer) in structured amounts with indications suggesting the purpose of funds is for a real estate-related transaction (such as memos referencing an address).
indicators.red_flag: Structured-amount China/HK inflows to real-estate party with address-memo references (structuring into property)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.flag: Cash deposit(s) are followed by funds sent to a real estate party (e.g., real estate agent/brokerage) with indications suggesting the purpose of payment is for a real estate-related transaction (such as memos referencing the same address repeatedly).
indicators.red_flag: Cash-in then push to real-estate party with repeated same-address memos (cash placement into property)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Client receives funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, marked for education or personal purposes (e.g., “tuition” or “living expense”), but funds are then used towards payments with indications suggesting the purpose of payment is for a real estate-related transaction (such as memos referencing “property purchase” or “mortgage”).
indicators.red_flag: Memo-purpose mismatch — "tuition"/"living expense" inflows redeployed to property/mortgage payments
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Mortgage payments are sourced from incoming funds from China, notably in Hong Kong, where the original source of funds is unclear.
indicators.red_flag: Mortgage serviced by China/HK inflows of unclear origin (source-of-funds gap into property)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.source: case-management / KYC remediation system + customer correspondence log

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to purchase shorter-term investment products (such as Guaranteed Investment Certificates), which are then redeemed before the term date, despite incurring a penalty.
indicators.red_flag: Buy-and-early-redeem short-term GICs despite penalty (wash-through investment layering)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D1.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are quickly transferred to holding companies, trust companies or investment firms.
indicators.red_flag: Rapid onward transfer of China/HK inflows to holding / trust / investment firms (layering through corporate vehicles)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Cash deposits are transferred within a short period of time to a holding company, trust company or investment firm.
indicators.red_flag: Cash-in then rapid push to holding / trust / investment firm (cash placement into corporate vehicle)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Cash deposits are transferred within a short period of time to vehicle import/export companies, often located in China, notably in Hong Kong.
indicators.red_flag: Cash-in then rapid push to vehicle import/export firms in China/HK (cash placement into trade channel)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to send funds to high-end car dealerships that are inconsistent with clients stated occupation.
indicators.red_flag: High-end car-dealership spend inconsistent with stated occupation (occupation-vs-activity mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to send funds to entities listed in the automotive sector who have newer profiles (1-2 years at most).
indicators.red_flag: Payments to recently-registered (1-2yr) automotive-sector entities (newly-formed counterparty risk)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to send funds to entities listed in the automotive sector who have residential addresses as their business locations.
indicators.red_flag: Payments to automotive entities operating from residential addresses (shell/nominee business)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D10 (Customer & account reference / entity-resolution data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to send funds to entities listed in the automotive sector who have limited to no online presence.
indicators.red_flag: Payments to no-web-footprint automotive entities (shell counterparty)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to send funds in a similar amount to a car dealership.
indicators.red_flag: Round/matched-amount pass-through of China/HK inflows to a car dealership (mirror-amount layering)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Circular flow of funds between different entities listed in the automotive industry and import/export entities, with one or more entity located in China, notably in Hong Kong.
indicators.red_flag: Circular fund flow among automotive and import/export entities including China/HK leg (round-tripping)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Outgoing fund transfers to entities operating in China, notably in Hong Kong, with references to the automotive industry (such as “car purchases” or “buying cars”) that are inconsistent with client’s stated occupation (e.g., student, homemaker or unemployed).
indicators.red_flag: Outbound China/HK "car purchase" memo transfers inconsistent with student/homemaker/unemployed profile (occupation mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Inter-account transfer from personal to business accounts (or vice-versa) sourced through high value domestic fund transfers from individuals/entities in the automotive sector.
indicators.red_flag: Personal↔business inter-account shuffling fed by high-value automotive-sector domestic transfers (layering)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: Client receiving funds from entities with no apparent online presence that appear to be involved in automotive import/export activities and are inconsistent with clients stated occupation or expected pattern of activities (e.g., student, homemaker, unemployed).
indicators.red_flag: Inflows from no-web-footprint auto import/export entities inconsistent with stated occupation (shell originator + occupation mismatch)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds of unknown origin from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are sent to a legal professional in structured amounts with no clear relationship or stated purpose.
indicators.red_flag: Structured-amount China/HK inflows to a legal professional with no relationship or purpose (structuring through legal trust channel)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D19.

indicators.flag: Incoming funds from individuals/entities located in China, notably in Hong Kong, are used to send funds to legal professionals who specialize in real estate and are inconsistent with client’s stated occupation or expected pattern of activities (e.g., student, homemaker, unemployed).
indicators.red_flag: Payments to real-estate legal professionals inconsistent with student/homemaker/unemployed profile (occupation mismatch via legal channel)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D19 (Legal/notary trust-account & third-party-funding data), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.flag: Client’s account is mainly or in part funded by bank drafts, email money transfers and/or cheques from legal professionals who have limited or no open source footprint.
indicators.red_flag: Account funded by drafts / EMT / cheques from no-web-footprint legal professionals (trust-account funding channel)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D19.

indicators.flag: Cash deposits, not in line with account holder’s stated occupation, were used to send funds to legal professionals with no clear relationship.
indicators.red_flag: Occupation-inconsistent cash-in pushed to no-relationship legal professionals (cash placement via legal channel)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D2.

indicators.flag: Financial transactions such as cash deposits/withdrawals, use of personal negotiable instruments (e.g., cheques), electronic funds transfers and foreign exchange using legal professional’s personal account.
indicators.red_flag: Legal professional's personal account used for cash / cheque / EFT / FX activity (commingling via personal account)
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C16 (Third-party / nominee funding & legal-professional channel detection); data D19.
